verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates coding agents, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The pack contains no evidence that Conductor lets users configure or connect external MCP servers for its agents to use. The only MCP evidence describes Conductor's own hosted MCP server, which lets outside clients manage workspaces; that is the opposite role and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
